rules: An observation collected from 48 hours before through 48 hours after index mNGS collection belongs to the same retrospective infection episode.
Use specimen collection time when available; report time is a provisional fallback and must retain a timing warning.
An older or later observation remains history/context and cannot serve as direct same-episode promotion evidence.
Antibiotic timing is retained when available but is not required to recognize an observation already inside the fixed episode window.
Same-episode evidence still requires organism identity and specimen/source compatibility; timing alone cannot create Picked.
